welcome_description: Load a Gravis Ultrasound .PAT file, a SoundFont .SF2/.SF3 file, a Surge VST2 .FXP preset, or a zipped .SFZ package. FXP wavetable data is converted to an approximate GUS patch; synth modulation and effects are not preserved. Edit patch properties, edit waveforms, import/export WAV files, and test sounds using your keyboard or MIDI. All data is stored in your browser's IndexedDB. Warning: SoundFont and SFZ packages are generally large, and their size can grow substantially when converted to GUS Patches. Make sure your computer has enough RAM and free storage.
